Episode 235. Zito (1)
Zito smirked and licked his lips with his tongue.
That tongue soon stretched out like a snake, wrapping around Zito. It was pricked by thorns and scraped, turning his body into a bloody purple mess in an instant.
'I felt this when fighting Ayula too, but he's truly insane.'
While it was a sight that made anyone watching feel pained, Zito seemed to enjoy the tingling sensation of his worn-out, drooping tongue.
[Hehehe, it looks painful, doesn’t it? But in fact, all of this is pleasure. You’ll understand it too. Not just you, but the whole world will understand.]
As Jin was about to respond, Zito rushed forward and swung his spiked axe. Kriik-! The ground where Jin was standing exploded, and black fragments scattered all around.
During a battle, flying rocks or dirt pose no problem to warriors who have reached a high level. But Jin could instinctively realize it.
Zito's dwelling, this vast void, was entirely Zito himself.
Therefore, each of the fragments that sprang from the ground was his flesh and could all become weapons.
Screeee……!
As expected, the fragments oxidized into a type of poisonous mist near Jin, and at the moment when Jin was about to scatter them with a sword wind, they transformed into thorns.
Jin also focused the widespread energy in an instant to slash the thorns. A loud noise erupted when the sword blade and the thorns collided.
[As expected, you have strong mental strength. Just touching my body with a weapon causes tremendous pain, but seeing that your expression doesn't change, it's more thrilling.]
The god of pain.
If such an entity existed, Zito would surely have been called that. Any sort of 'contact' with Zito meant being engulfed in pain.
[But even your mental strength won't be limitless. I wonder how many days you can hold out while fighting me? One day? Two days? Three days?]
Zito didn't even consider his own defeat. He was just curious about how much time it would take for him to win.
Even the Chansung (Creation) could not kill him.
Parellito had already proven that in the past, and in Zito's opinion, for Jin to have any chance of winning, a serious problem would have to occur with the artificial sun.
But the artificial sun was being protected by Ridolros. Since no problem had occurred with the artificial sun so far, Zito was confident that Biseptus would have been annihilated by now.
[By the way, Phaelito couldn't even last a day. But you are probably better than that fool, right? I bet you can last two days.]
Two spiky axes were continuously hitting the ground. Jin was trying his best to distance himself from them, to avoid directly crossing his sword with them.
Although he was accustomed to enduring pain during fights, he needed to observe Zito while avoiding his attacks.
'I need to seize the opportunity to finish it in one go.'
Jin was certain.
If the fight drags on, he is bound to lose.
Zito's power here will never run out, and an ordinary sword can't even land a proper hit on him.
Furthermore, he had to dodge his attacks or deflect debris more often than he breathed. Naturally, it was unfair to fight against the 'top-tier immortal' without any constraints.

[It seems like you've had quite a struggle trying to eliminate my flesh outside. As you can see now, such losses are meaningless. Just like nothing changes even if you scoop out a handful of sand from the desert. There is no mortal that can stand against me.]
“We'll find out if that was really meaningless after the fight is over.”
He was done calculating. As Sigmund held the gold lightning, Jin's vicinity brightened. Following that, Jin swung his sword not at Zito, but first towards the sky.
King’s Sword, Gold Lightning Technique
Breaking Sky, 1st Form

This was the gold lightning technique influenced by Phaelito's sword dance. Just like when he shattered Ayula's protective shield in the Holy Kingdom, the enormous sword energy was splitting the dark sky in half.
The sky was opening. Beyond the splitting black sky, as if a thin membrane was being torn apart, another darkness was revealing itself.
That darkness was the abyss of hell. Zito's residence was located beneath that abyss.
[Ah, I closed it because I hate seeing it. And you open it wide like this? It's harmful to you, too. I don't want you to get hurt before I get to play with you.]
Of course, Jin didn't expect there to be an abyss there.
He simply judged it would be better to destroy Zito's dwelling if possible. He also needed to create an area where he could drop the gold lightning.
'Judging by the reaction, it seems that the darkness above the sky has nothing to do with Zito's power.'
Zito seemed to have no intention of hiding the fact that he 'hates the abyss', trembling in rage. That space was the domain of the witch Helrum.
Soon, Zito tried to close the sky again, but Jin was preparing to drop the gold lightning again after spreading the sky once more.
The gold lightning gathered like a thundercloud was covering the abyss and turning Zito's sky into Jin's sky.
King’s Sword, Gold Lightning Technique
Breaking the Heavens Style 2
The sharp flash temporarily obscured Zito's sight.
Of course, as an immortal, he could easily replace his sight with insight. However, the fact that he had lost his physical senses even for a moment was surprising.
That was something that Phaelito in his prime could not accomplish.
He had once cut through his own sky with a sword of heaven's destruction, but as soon as he faced the abyss, he had given up trying to attack from there.
'Is it because of the blessing of Solderet? Come to think of it, he seemed unaffected by the abyss.'
From Zito's perspective, it was shocking to see that Jin was not affected by the abyss at all.
"Jin Runcandel, I had high regard for you, but you turned out to be even greater than I thought...! You're perfectly fine even when facing the abyss of the witch?"
"Why do you keep babbling on? Just enjoy the lightning, it'll be thrilling."
"Kyahahaahak!"
Thousands of golden lightning bolts were pouring down. Each time the lightning struck Zito, a few of the thorns in his body broke.

Many of the poles rising in the void also broke. The souls bound above them shattered like glass and scattered somewhere as soon as the poles broke, and the creatures in pain were greeted with the relief of death and extinction.
Occasionally, the spot where there were souls and lives would automatically leave a golden mark of regeneration. Mostly, they simply disappeared without leaving a mark.
Normally, he would have wondered what the difference was, but now was the time to fully focus on the battle.

Jin began to whip Breaking the Heavens Style 2 more fiercely by amplifying his mad heart. Lightning, even more massive and threatening than the Royal Sword Technique he unleashed before ascending, was pouring down.
The thunderous noise that filled the space in layers, and Zito's physical body being indiscriminately destroyed within it.
Zito was truly screaming with joy from the pain he felt from others for the first time in a long time. Jin amplified the thunderous noise because he didn't like to hear that.
"So you call that thing a god."
He had to give him a dreadful attack that he couldn't dare to enjoy.
However, Jin raining down thousands of branches of golden lightning on Zito right now was not a unilateral attack, contrary to what it seemed.
As he had already experienced at the beginning, anyone facing Zito here falls into pain every time they make any kind of contact with him.
It was the same even when it wasn't a direct clash of weapons, but a clash of energies. Moreover, since the golden lightning was now filling the entire void, Jin had to consume mental energy rapidly.
It didn't show on his face at all. Jin had a serene face, just like when he was meditating earlier.
However, inside him, he had to constantly push away the penetrating power of pain. It felt as if Zito's thorns were pricking his skin, point by point.
"I've never lost in an inner war, Zito. I wonder if you can do the same."
[Heh... Hahaha! The more you endure, the more I anticipate and enjoy. Even if the whole world falls asleep in the pain I spread, you will amuse me forever with your consciousness.]
Jin amplified the Pacheon once more.
The void space had already lost its original form, turning into a black desert, and Zito was on one knee, all the spikes on his body broken.
He seemed to be barely hanging on, relying on two spiked axes stuck in the ground. But that was just a posture he took to enjoy the pain, he was not yet in a real crisis.
He saw right through Jin's thoughts.
[Jin Runcandel, you want a chance to kill me in one go, and you probably have the means to do that.]
Splitting the Sun, and the completed Myungwang Gunrim Sword.
After being certain that he had to kill Zito in one blow, Jin judged that only those two swords could perform the task.
But even if he reached Genesis, it was impossible for Jin to unfold the Myungwang Gunrim Sword with the same power as it had in its prime.
While the Splitting the Sun wasn't yet complete, it seemed capable of delivering a substantial blow to Zito. This felt even more certain after confronting Zito directly.
He was not stronger than the Solderet he meditated on and formed in his inner world. If he could cut that Solderet, cutting Zito wouldn't be too difficult.
[But I have no intention of giving you that opportunity. It's true that I cherish you terribly, but that would put the cart before the horse, wouldn't it?]
Zito began to slowly rise.

Jin didn't strengthen the Pacheon's thunderbolt any further. Because he had to control his strength. If he used more energy on the Pacheon now, he might lack the energy to respond to the variables that would occur later.
Above all, he had to save energy to deploy Splitting the Sun. The key to this battle was to cut Zito with Splitting the Sun at the perfect moment.
[Huuh! That's enough to enjoy the start, let's start the real game now. This is actually a very simple fight, Jin Runcandel. In the end, the victory depends on who endures better between you and me.]
Suddenly, Zito was back behind Jin, forming a physical body again. The broken spikes had all grown back and the wounds that had opened and burst were all healed and intact.

[You said you never lost an inner fight, right? But Jin Runcandel, this is not our inner world, it's reality. No matter how well you block the pain that digs into your inner world, if you can't kill the real me, it's meaningless. Hehe...!]
Zito swung his spiked axe and smiled. One of the spikes on the axe grazed Jin's cheek as it passed by.
